one_line: A magical crayon that lets a player draw colourful, reusable magical stencil decals (bounce pads, light, fentanyl gas, whoopee cushion, landmine, spinner) on floors, up to 15 drawings.
player_facing_mechanics: Use the crayon on a valid open floor turf to draw the currently selected stencil (2 second do_after, no drawing if floor already has a wizcrayon decal or the target isn't an open floor)
Left-click/UI choose the paint colour (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple) which tints the drawn decal
Right-click/UI choose the ruin (stencil) type from all /obj/effect/decal/cleanable/wizcrayon subtypes
Crayon has 15 total uses and is destroyed when the last use is spent
UI shows remaining uses as a percentage
flip decal: anything crossing it gets a spin animation and a cartoon boing sound
spore decal: crossing carbon mobs get drugginess, dizziness and confusion for 10-20 seconds and a lucid smell message (only if not already drugged/stat)
fart decal: crossing it plays a fart sound, then goes on a 15 second cooldown before it can fire again
glow decal: emits a light (range 3, power 5) tinted by the drawn colour
boom decal: living mobs of at least human size crossing get sparks, a colour wash and a message, then the decal destroys itself after 6 ticks
spin decal: mobs crossing it are spun (10 spins) with a woink sound
tg_systems_used: turfs/decals and contents lookup (locate in turf contents)
data_only_parts: name/desc/icon/icon_state and w_class stat overrides on the crayon and every decal subtype
the paint colour table (name -> COLOR_CRAYON_* constant)
the stencil-name-to-type mapping (derived from subtypesof at runtime)
per-decal metadata like the fart cooldown duration and the boom destruction delay
logic_parts: isValidSurface checks (open floor turf, no existing wizcrayon decal)
use_on: do_after, spawn the selected decal, apply active_color, decrement uses, destroy at zero, recompute percent and refresh UI
create_ui: reading the HTML file and building the colour/stencil alists
drawing_crossed handlers for each subtype (flip, spore, fart + its reset timer, boom + its timed Destroy, spin)
byond_specific: Custom SSfrogui HTML UI built from file2text('surfshack13/frogui/wizcrayon.html') and driven by href topic callbacks (frog_ui_topic / ui_interact / ui_data)
BYOND static alist fields (paint_colors, stencil_buttons, ui)
DMI icon files and flick() icon_state animation frames
BYOND signal registration on the movable crossing (COMSIG_MOVABLE_CROSS)
port_notes: The drawing behaviour and per-decal on-cross effects port cleanly to SS14 components/systems: the crayon becomes an item with a DrawDecal component and an Action/verb-driven colour+stencil picker UI, and each stencil becomes a prototype entity plus a component reacting to a step/collision event, using DoAfter for the 2s draw and a light component for the glow decal. The main work is replacing the custom SSfrogui href UI with a proper UI system (or an Action menu / radial) and modelling the 'no existing decal here' placement rule as a tile check. Design questions: whether magic drawings should be a full custom grid/tile-overlay system vs. free-placed decals, how to preserve the reusable multi-use crayon durability, and whether each stencil's effect should be a distinct component (recommended) or one data-driven system.
